FAIL_CLOSED_RULE: Any failed prerequisite/result denies success and dependent guard; preserve original native/wrapper exception, failing step, actual observed side effects and process status. Do not repair/mutate sources or policy.

READER.FUTURE_RESULT_HANDLING: Structured error classification + original native/wrapper exception type/message + failing boundary. No source/policy/state repair; no lifecycle mutation or output oracle inferred.
READER.before writer exit: WRITER_EXIT_NOT_OBSERVED / RUNTIME_GUARDS_UNMET; supervisor gate before launch
READER.decode failure: Native parse_json/_unwire exception recorded with operation boundary restore
READER.missing persisted file: Native PlannerError bundle unavailable (wrapper file read may surface OSError before restore; classified persisted input unavailable)
READER.validation failure: Native PlannerError exact message/type retained; no PASS from exit code
READER.warm-state leakage: WARM_READER / forbidden input-channel schema; no reader launch
READER.wrong bytes/hash/bundle ID: PERSISTED_BYTES_MISMATCH wrapper or native bundle identity mismatch
READER.wrong policy/P05: WRONG_FRAME_POLICY_OR_REPLAY_SCOPE or native unsupported selection policy identity/version binding
READER.wrong source pin: RESTORED_SOURCE_SET_MISMATCH or native pinned source/provenance validation error

WRITER.after_publication_verification: Visible exact file alone cannot satisfy handoff/exit; reader denied
WRITER.after_save_return: G1 possibly observed but remaining gates denied until actual publication/handoff/exit independently complete
WRITER.before_exit_observation: No G4, reader denied even if all files visible
WRITER.during_save: No success/handoff/exit qualification assumed; staged/final artifact may or may not exist, no rollback/crash guarantee
